description: This Python script generates a YAML configuration file listing operators used in specific PyTorch models for selective build purposes. It processes model metadata, operator dependency graphs, and root operator lists to produce a detailed YAML with operator inclusion, metadata, and build configuration, supporting static and traced operator analysis.

classes.description: Represents an operator for selective build, with methods to generate from YAML dict and convert to dict.

methods.name: is_new_style_rule(model_name: str, model_versions: list[str] | None)
methods.description: Determines if a rule uses the new style operator library based on model name and versions.

methods.name: None verify_all_specified_present( model_assets: list[str] | None, model_versions: list[str], selected_models_yaml: list[dict[str, Any]], rule_name: str, model_name: str, new_style_rule: bool, )
methods.description: Checks that specified model assets and versions are present in the YAML files.
